resolution.note: open-red count skips pending Check and fresh no-run PRs; test/rules/open-red-limit.test.ts covers pending, failed, stale and fresh no-run

title: Open-red lane limit counts PRs with a running Check as red
body:
On 2026-11-17 `krn lane start` refused with "open-red limit: 3 open PRs have a red or missing Check (#1321, #1320, #1319)" while all three had every job green except Test (12/13) still running: the open-red count (#1316, t-z0q36nh) counts a PR whose Check is in progress as missing, so three shipping lanes block every new lane until CI ends.
Outcome: a PR whose Check is queued or in progress does not count toward KRN_OPEN_RED_MAX; a failed Check, and a PR with no Check run at all after its head is older than a grace period, still count.
Proof: a lane test over gh fixtures (one pending, one failed, one without a run) asserts only the failed and the stale no-run PR are counted.
Files: src/cli/lane-open-red.ts, test/rules/open-red-limit.test.ts
